notes.title: 🪨0.2.14 ~ The Broken Stone Bewails the Sky✨
notes.content:
[previewyoutube="bSV8W-XbCx8;full"][/previewyoutube]Juice Galaxy 0.2.14 ~ The Broken Stone Bewails the Sky
Yay! We have destructible mesh physics now!

We can use this for a ton of interesting destructible things, but for starters I'm scattering some planetoids around in the sky. After the dust settles, I have some more interesting ideas for this mechanic. We definitely need some kind of mini-boss in the sky!

Planetoids
These are destructible islands in the sky, made of semi-solid juice that crumbles under your touch. Destroying terrain will produce juice, and spawn items/monsters.

Any collision of sufficient force will damage the planetoid, releasing rock/dust particles and updating the mesh collider/renderer to take damage.

Planetoids spawn pretty high up so you can barely see any from the ground. As you gain altitude, they get bigger until you reach the plywood.

The Sky
The upper sky hasn't been updated since version 0.0.1! Since I was already working on the planetoids, it was a good time to make it more menacing! It is now difficult to climb, as gravity increases up to 20x, and I've adjusted the lighting to get really freaky up there.

Stewart Keller also provided a new music track, Zenith, to play in the upper atmosphere. I asked him for something gigantic, industrial, and ominous and he did not disappoint!

notes.title: 🪱Juice Galaxy 0.2.13⚡~ Fleaches, Damage Numbers, and Electricity Improvements,
notes.content:
[previewyoutube="o57B3Z3THCk;full"][/previewyoutube]🪱Juice Galaxy 0.2.13 ⚡~ Fleaches, Damage Numbers, and Lightning


Hello! I hope everyone has been well!

I ended up taking a pretty long break since the last update, and now I'm gearing up for the next wave of updates. For this one, we are starting small just to make sure I still know what I am doing.


Fleaches!
A brand new monster! The Fleach is a leech-like creature that latches onto living things and drinks their Juice. It will also seek out and gobble up corpses on the ground. Once it latches on, it deals continuous damage and sucks Juice based on the damage done. You can get your juice back by killing and eating it. It spawns in the wilderness and from Rocks that are destroyed.


Damage Numbers
Finally you can see how much damage you are doing. Enable them in Visual settings tab. Next up I'll try and add health bars!


Lightning improvements
I took some time to polish up the electrical system, making its animation and sound more dynamic while also improving its chaining capabilities, visuals, audio, and level scaling.

Added a proper animation. Lightning arcs now take time to travel through the air, instead of all happening instantaneously.

Arcs now deal slightly reduced damage (75%) with each bounce.

Chain range increased 60 => 100, and chain logic fixed so it can hit more targets if they’re close together.

Arc width and pitch now depends on the amount of damage it’s doing. Massive zaps sound pretty crazy.

For the Grimoire: Arc spell, # of chain bounces now scales with item level


Changelog:[code]## \[0.2.13]
### Added
- New Monster: Fleach (spawns from Rocks killed)
- Damage numbers (can be enabled in Settings menu)

### Changed
- Lightning arcs now take time to travel through the air
- Lightning chain range buffed 60 => 100, chain logic improved
- Each time lightning bounces, its damage drops 25%
- 'Grimoire: Arc' number of chains now scales with item level
- DollSystem logic for more control over damage/knockback

### Fixed
- Lightning audio pitch now properly scales with damage
- Chests on ruins rarely spawning anything but prismatic juice
- Fire damage doing tiny amounts of negative damage sometimes

notes.title: 🎩 Juice Galaxy 0.2.12 ~ Paewol and Demo Version 🎩
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=HLq59ihTxE0;full][/previewyoutube]
Juice Galaxy Demo
Hello! It's been a sec, I hope everyone is doing really well.

This is a complex update, since it splits Juice Galaxy into two versions: the Demo and the Full Version.
In the demo, the player can explore the overworld and fight two bosses: the Creator and Mrs. Slitherss.

What's new in the Full Version:New NPC: Paewol (spawnable via console)New Hat: Monitor HatImproved fix for Mac GUI glitchGeneral logic to accommodate demo version alongside main gameMain differences in Demo Version:Paywall forcefields around wilderness, Wawsp Nest, and BubbletropolisCertain items are off limits (and spawn more infrequently)Toilet Realm and Dream Realm cannot be enteredDemo Gatekeeper NPC: PaewolSpawns when player attempts something not available in the demoGives intro speech in graveyard after schoolGives outro speech in graveyard after bosses defeated
Woe to those who do not heed his warnings

Paewol is a friendly demo guide who shows up to explain paywalls to the player. He (probably) cannot die in the demo, but if you mess with him enough, he will get annoyed and obliterate you. In the full version, you can spawn him via the console and get your revenge.

Let me know if have any feedback at: JuiceGalaxyBugs@gmail.com


Next up, I look forward to getting back to work on the main game. Thank you for playing!

notes.title: JG 0.2.10 ~ Bubbletropolis
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=2BS1Vkkit2k;full][/previewyoutube]

It's been a minute. I hope everyone has been well!

My main goal with this update is to get ready to move the story forward, by adding key storytelling mechanics and doing a bit of worldbuilding with Bubbletropolis. While I wouldn't say the town is done yet, we have a solid start.

There are a couple big changes in this update:
- Bubbletropolis has been added to the game
- Ingot can now join your party for adventure

Ingot can now join you on your adventures! Just talk to him in the graveyard and ask him to follow you. He will loosely follow you, killing everything in sight when he's not busy chasing after you. If you get in the car, he will hop on for a ride. If certain conditions are met (most quests complete) he will start you on a quest to go to Bubbletropolis.

Bubbletropolis can be found by taking the road past Hoagen's mushroom out into the wilderness. In this town, Bubblians toil away making bubbles for the Juice Queen. They are behind quota, and do not appreciate when their bubbles are popped. While the area is fairly fleshed out, I have bigger plans for it in the future. This update merely introduces the location, and I look forward to taking the next step with a future update.

Please let me know if have any feedback on the update. Especially since I've probably introduced some cool new bugs with the NPC follower system.

Enjoy the game, and thank you so much for playing. ^^

notes.title: Juice Galaxy 0.2.9 ~ Bubble Flurry Spell
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=x4qyodePto8;full][/previewyoutube]

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44624513/b40b50e2279eddc9159ae5e4d185aa2095368102.png

Heya! We are kicking off the next wave of updates with a small one.

This update introduces the Bubble Flurry spell, which can be spawned with the console:
[code]spawn grimoire:_bubble_flurry[/code]
Fire bubbles at your foes, which will stick to them and expand. If you hit them with enough bubbles, they will merge into a bubble prison, which traps a monster inside and eventually explodes. Firing more bubbles into the prison will cause it to expand and strengthen.

This update is the first part of several to come which will focus on moving the story forward. For starters, we are just making sure that the new bubble technology has not introduced (many) new bugs and checking the balance and feel of the new spell.

There are also two new 'monsters' in the spawnlist: the Bubblian and the Bubble. These are meant for a future update, but for now you can spawn them with the console:
[code]spawn bubble
spawn bubblian[/code]

Please don't hesitate to report any issues or share your thoughts ^^ if all goes well, this update should be out soon and I will continue working on the top-secret next story chapter.

notes.content:
[previewyoutube=2_mn2DlRRNY;full][/previewyoutube]

This is a small update with some bug fixes and a small holiday event! 🧑‍🎄

It's snowing in the overworld, and you can find present boxes scattered across the overworld.

There are two new items for this event:
- Santa Hat
- Candy Cane

The holiday event is coded to recurr every year from Dec 13th to Jan 7th. If you miss the window, you can still spawn elements using the console like so:
spawn candy_cane
spawn santa_hat
spawn present_box

If I can next year, I'll add something spicy to make it more of a big event >:)

Thanks for playing, and enjoy the update! Happy holidays!
